13-Day Turkey & Egypt Explorer: Cappadocia and the Nile
summary:
The 13-Day Explore Turkey & Egypt Tour gives Turkey and Upper Egypt separate stages, linking Istanbul and Cappadocia with Cairo before continuing south along the Nile. Explore Istanbul and Cappadocia first, then fly to Cairo for the Pyramids of Giza and other scheduled visits. From there, continue to Aswan for a three-night full-board cruise toward Luxor, with guided sightseeing during the river journey and time to explore the major temples and monuments along the route.
The escorted package includes selected 4-star hotels, breakfast, cruise meals, professional local guides, airport transfers, entrance fees, scheduled sightseeing and five domestic flights.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Istanbul
itinerary.text:
Upon arrival at Istanbul Airport (IST or SAW), meet our representative and transfer to your hotel.
Check-in is available after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul Oldcity Walking Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, enjoy a guided tour of Istanbul. Visit the historic Hippodrome of Constantinople, including the Egyptian Obelisk, Serpentine Column, and Fountain of Wilhelm II. Continue to the iconic Blue Mosque and the magnificent Hagia Sophia. After lunch, explore the atmospheric Basilica Cistern, famous for its ancient columns and underground beauty. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Bosphorus Cruise- Flight to Cappadocia
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, visit the historic Spice Bazaar, also known as the Egyptian Bazaar, famous for its colorful spices, sweets, and local products since 1665. Continue with a memorable Bosphorus cruise, sailing between Europe and Asia along one of the world’s most scenic waterways. After the tour, transfer to the airport at 15:00 for your flight to Nevsehir at 18:45. Upon arrival at 20:10, and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: North Cappadocia Tour
itinerary.text:
Optional: Early morning hot air balloon ride over Cappadocia.
After breakfast at 10:00, enjoy a full-day tour of North Cappadocia. Visit Uchisar Castle for panoramic views, followed by Rose Valley, Pasabag, and the Zelve Open Air Museum, famous for fairy chimneys and cave dwellings. After lunch, continue to Devrent Valley and Three Beauties, then visit the charming towns of Urgup and Avanos, known for traditional pottery. After the tour, return to the hotel. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: South Cappadocia tour- Flight to Istanbul
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 10:00, enjoy a full-day tour of South Cappadocia. Visit Ortahisar Castle, Mustafapasa, Sobesos Ancient City, and Soganli Valley. After lunch, explore Kaymakli Underground City. After the tour Transfer to Kayseri Airport for your flight to Istanbul (19:30–21:00). Arrival and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul to Cairo by Flight
itinerary.text:
Breakfast. Check out and transfer to Istanbul Airport for your flight to Cairo (14:00–15:15).
Upon arrival, meet and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Visit Pyramids and Sphinx
itinerary.text: Meet your guide and visit Memphis, the ancient capital of Egypt, and see the impressive statue of Ramesses II. Continue to Saqqara to explore the famous Pyramid of Djoser. Afterwards, visit the legendary Giza pyramid complex and admire the iconic Great Sphinx of Giza. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Egyptian Museum, Old Cairo
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel in Cairo. Visit the impressive Grand Egyptian Museum and the historic Cairo Citadel, including the beautiful Mosque of Muhammad Ali. Continue to explore Old Cairo with visits to the The Hanging Church and Saints Sergius and Bacchus Church (Abu Serga Church). End the day at the famous Khan el-Khalili Bazaar. Overnight in Cairo.

itinerary.title: Flight to Aswan - Nile Cruise
itinerary.text: Early breakfast box and transfer to the airport for your morning flight from Cairo to Aswan (06:30–07:50). Upon arrival, meet your guide and transfer to board your 3-night Nile River cruise before lunch. Begin sightseeing in Aswan with a visit to the impressive Aswan High Dam, followed by the beautiful Philae Temple located on Agilkia Island and dedicated to the goddess Isis. Return to the cruise ship. Overnight on board the Nile cruise.

itinerary.title: Nile Cruise - Kom Ombo and Edfu Sightseeing
itinerary.text: Sail to Kom Ombo and visit the Temple of Kom Ombo, dedicated to the crocodile god Sobek. Continue sailing to Edfu and explore the remarkably preserved Temple of Edfu, dedicated to the falcon god Horus. Return to the cruise ship and continue sailing along the Nile River. Overnight on board the Nile cruise.

itinerary.title: Nile Cruise - Visit Luxor
itinerary.text: Sail along the Nile River to Esna and continue onward to Luxor. Begin exploring the West Bank of Luxor with a visit to the legendary Valley of the Kings, burial site of many ancient pharaohs. Continue to the magnificent Mortuary Temple of Hatshepsut, dedicated to Egypt’s famous female pharaoh. End the tour with a stop at the impressive Colossi of Memnon. Return to the cruise ship. Overnight on board the Nile cruise.

itinerary.title: Luxor to Cairo By flight
itinerary.text: Breakfast onboard and disembark in Luxor. Visit the magnificent Luxor Temple and the vast Karnak Temple Complex, one of the largest religious sites in the world. Enjoy some free time before transfer to the airport for your flight to Cairo. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Cairo.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 13-Day Classic Turkey and Egypt Tour?
faqs.a: The 13-Day Classic Turkey and Egypt Tour covers Istanbul and Cappadocia in Turkey, along with Cairo, Luxor, and Aswan in Egypt. This carefully designed itinerary combines two of the world's most remarkable civilizations, offering a journey through ancient history, cultural treasures, iconic monuments, and unforgettable landscapes. The tour runs for 12 nights and 13 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 13-Day Classic Turkey and Egypt Tour cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €2,775 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, guided sightseeing tours, selected meals, airport and hotel transfers, domestic transportation, and five domestic flights. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates and hotel category.

faqs.q: Are flights included in the package?
faqs.a: Yes, five domestic flights are included within the itinerary. These flights allow travelers to comfortably cover long distances while maximizing sightseeing opportunities in both Turkey and Egypt. International flights are not included unless specifically stated.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes accommodation in carefully selected hotels throughout Turkey and Egypt. Daily breakfast is included, while additional meals may be provided according to the itinerary. Hotels are chosen for their comfort, quality service, and convenient locations.

Yes, professional English-speaking guides accompany the scheduled sightseeing tours in both Turkey and Egypt. Your guides will provide fascinating insights into the history, archaeology, culture, and traditions of each destination.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Turkey and Egypt?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors. It combines the most famous highlights of both countries, allowing travelers to experience world-renowned historical sites, local culture, and spectacular scenery in one seamless itinerary.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, museums, historical districts, and uneven terrain. Most visitors with average fitness levels can comfortably participate throughout the journey.

faqs.q: What are the highlights of the tour?
faqs.a: Highlights include the Hagia Sophia, Blue Mosque, Grand Bazaar, and Bosphorus in Istanbul; the fairy chimneys, cave churches, and underground cities of Cappadocia; the Pyramids of Giza and Egyptian Museum in Cairo; the Valley of the Kings, Karnak Temple, and Luxor Temple in Luxor; and the beautiful Nile scenery and ancient temples of Aswan.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 13-Day Classic Turkey and Egypt Tour?
faqs.a: Free cancellation is available up to 60 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 60 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms, airline conditions, and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is strongly recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Can the 13-Day Classic Turkey and Egypt Tour be customized?
faqs.a: Yes, the tour can be customized according to your preferences. You can add extra nights, upgrade hotel categories, include a Nile Cruise, extend your stay in Cappadocia, or add Red Sea destinations such as Hurghada or Sharm El Sheikh. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
